summary: Experienced local backcountry skier Dave Penney was caught in a soft-slab avalanche Thursday afternoon on Schuykill Ridge and carried downhill, suffering a compound leg fracture; his girlfriend Danika Gilbert reached him, splinted the leg with avalanche shovel handles and ski straps, and they called 911 via cell phone; roughly 20 CBSAR volunteers responded and a helicopter landed on a bench 1,000 ft below to fly him to Gunnison for surgery
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue + helicopter
notes: Crested Butte News Dec 2014; slide 25 ft wide, 12-20 in deep, ran ~300 ft; danger rated moderate on near-treeline slopes
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Gunnison County, Colorado, United States)
